_note: What enemies say and the noises creatures make in a fight (world/combat/combat_barks.gd). voices: a kind of talking enemy, the monsters that speak with it and its lines for each moment (battle: when it first acts; strike: when its attack lands; hurt: a heavy blow on it; death: as it falls); each kind speaks as the speaker bark_<kind> (audio/voice/casting.json), on eleven_v3 with its delivery in square brackets (owner, 2026-10-07: these are fights for their lives, so every line is fierce, desperate or gloating). noises: a kind of creature that doesn't talk, its monsters and, for each moment, sound-effect prompts with their length in seconds, made as the speaker noise_<kind>. Both are generated by make voice (ADR 0013) and keyed by the text, so an edited line or prompt makes a new clip.
